item.title: First article about a rocket launch
item.content:encoded: ENCODED BODY: the rocket lifted off from the pad at dawn carrying twelve satellites into a polar orbit, and the booster returned to the landing zone eight minutes later without incident.

item.title: Second article about a merger
item.description: SUMMARY BODY: the two companies agreed to merge in an all-stock deal valued at four billion euros, pending approval from competition regulators in Brussels later this year.
